name: Icon

props.note: Each icon is its own component in Icons — Library. Pick one, or swap through an INSTANCE_SWAP property such as iconStart.
Not a property. Figma icons are 24×24, which is lg in code. Resize the instance to 16 (sm), 20 (md, the code default), 24 (lg) or 32 (xl).
Not a property. Bind the vector stroke to an icon/* color variable; the names match the code color values.
Accessible name for informative icons. Not drawn.

purpose: Renders a glyph from the @lockin/icons set (24×24 stroke icons). Decorative by default; becomes an image with a name when given a label.

props.name: name
props.description: Icon id. List with GET /api/icons or the MCP tool list_icons.

props.name: color
props.description: Semantic icon color (color.icon.*). Defaults to the surrounding text color.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Provide only when the icon stands alone and conveys meaning.

props.name: tint
props.description: Raw color override, used to match a parent's text color (React Native has no currentColor inheritance).

tokens.usage: Color options map to color.icon.* tokens.
Supporting icons inside inputs and controls.

accessibility.focus: Icons are never focusable themselves; wrap in Button or Link for interaction.
notes: Informative icons need ≥3:1 contrast against their background; all color.icon.* tokens meet this on default backgrounds.
In Windows High Contrast mode icons inherit CanvasText.

variants.name: decorative
variants.description: Paired with visible text that already conveys the meaning.
variants.useWhen: Icons in buttons with labels, list bullets.

variants.name: informative
variants.description: Stands alone and must be named.
variants.useWhen: A status icon in a table cell with no text.

do: Pair icons with text whenever possible.
Use status icons (check-circle, alert-triangle, alert-circle, info) alongside status colors.
Use currentColor so icons follow text color and theme changes.
dont: Don't make an Icon clickable; use Button iconOnly.
Don't label an icon that sits next to text saying the same thing (double announcement).
Don't hard-code hex colors on icons.
